title: event-envelope/v1
description: The envelope every event on every topic carries (ADR-025 §1). CloudEvents-compatible names. `data` is validated separately against schemas/<eventType>.v<schemaVersion>.json. Ids and states only, never customer PII.

eventId.description: ULID; unique; the consumer dedupe key. Equals the producer's outbox_id.

schemaVersion.description: Major version of the data schema; increments only on a breaking change

source.description: Producing context / service id, e.g. payment. Also the {context} segment of the topic name.

aggregateType.description: UPPER_SNAKE entity name, e.g. PAYMENT. Lower-kebab form is the {aggregate} segment of the topic name.

aggregateId.description: Id of the entity the event is about; the Kafka partition key (ordering per aggregate)

occurredAt.description: RFC 3339 UTC instant the business fact happened

journeyId.description: Correlation across contexts; null when the fact precedes a journey

leadId.description: Correlation across contexts; null when not lead-originated

traceId.description: Distributed trace id (W3C trace-id or platform trace)

correlationId.description: X-Correlation-Id of the request that caused the change

configVersionRef.description: Rule-set / config version that decided the change (ADR-024), e.g. CONSENT.POLICY@1.0.0; null when no configuration decided it

data.description: Event payload; schema per eventType. Ids and states only — never customer PII.

actor.description: Who caused the change, in what capacity (INV-ACT-04). actorInsurerId and assistedActorId are required for an INSURER_PARTNER_REP.

type.description: Principal type, e.g. BANK_RM, INSURER_PARTNER_REP, CUSTOMER, SYSTEM

actingCapacity.description: INV-ACT-04; null for SYSTEM and CUSTOMER actors
